note: The player's body: one figure the project owner uploaded, 370 304 triangles, quantized geometry and webp textures written by gltfpack. The upload has no skin and no animations; rigged.glb is the same figure shaped into an A-pose and bound to 23 joints in KayKit's names by tools/rig_player.py, and rig.json carries the per-bone constants that re-home the vendored clips onto that rest. model.glb stays as the source of record; the game fetches rigged.glb and rig.json.
